_comment: d1 #247 FoTI extension -- Rags's INN register, gated on rags_meeting_settled AND absent drove_off_rags -- stated identically on her row's present_when and in WIInnGuests.GUEST_POOL_GATES -- so a betrayal win never seats her and never leaves a ghost-empty chair either. Attached ONLY to the rags_inn_guest entity; rags_meeting out on the floodplains never rides along, so the medicine trade, the carved pawn, the price and the draw-steel close all stay on the plains. REGISTER-PURE also means NO WAR PLANNING: no tribe numbers, no raids, no Watch sweeps, nothing she would say to goblins. What is left is a chieftain slumming it and proud of it, who counted the doors before she sat down and will not stop knowing where they are. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: EARLY Rags, one to four words, no articles, no fluency -- the register does not soften because the room is warm, and the intelligence shows in what she chooses to say. Book-17 bar: pre-Vol-5 characterization ONLY. Serve mirrors selys_inn/zevara_inn: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, four one-verb effect dicts.

greet.speaker: Rags
greet.text: Human place. Warm. I count doors first. Two. Window there. Then I sit.

options.text: Push a bowl across the table to her. (Serve)
"You don't have to watch the doors in here."

offduty.speaker: Rags
offduty.text: Always watch doors. Not for here. For after. ...Tables here flat. No wobble. Tribe has rocks. I do not complain. Inn Human cooks. Plays chess. Feeds goblins. Stupid. Works. Hate that it works.

options.text: Push a bowl across the table to her. (Serve)
"Don't tell her. She'd only be smug."

served.speaker: Rags
served.text: Hot. Good. ...Chieftain eats last. Always last. Tonight, first. Tell no one.
